<!-- en -->
v0.2.2 adds DeepSeek Harness (DSH) as a first-class collector: the desktop/CLI session logs under `~/.dsh/sessions` are now collected, including fork-inherited prefixes, retry attempts, and zero-value reversals. No command contracts break in this release.

### Highlights
- **DeepSeek Harness is collected.** DSH stores one append-only JSONL per session — by default as concatenated zstd frames — with a `session` header (`id`, `cwd`, `parentSession`, `isSeeded`) and per-request `assistant/message` records carrying provider/model and four-bucket usage. The collector discovers sessions, scans zstd frame boundaries, decodes complete frames under a budget, and books per-`(turn, step, attempt)` messages. Fork sessions are cut at the last `session/end-seed{inherited:true}`: only the child's own usage is counted, never the inherited prefix. Only the **v4** session format is accepted (plain and `.zstd` logs); other versions are skipped with a warning. A structurally incomplete trailing zstd frame is skipped whole — partial records inside it are not recovered, so if the source file is never repaired that usage may stay missing.
- **The daemon collects DSH without a file watcher.** DSH logs are zstd frames and the JSONL watcher only recognizes `.jsonl`, so DSH is driven by a periodic full submission. Enabling `dsh` alone is enough for `daemon start`; unchanged sessions hit the parse cache and still replay their results for idempotent persistence.

### New & Changed
- **Configuration**: `[clients.dsh]` with `paths.sessions_dir`, defaulting to `~/.dsh/sessions`. `collect --client dsh`, `errors --source dsh`, and `config init` include it; `DSH_HOME` is not read — users with a custom root set `sessions_dir` explicitly.
- **Accounting**: `inputTokens` is already uncached input, so FreshInput equals Input (cache reads are not subtracted); `outputTokens` includes reasoning; `totalTokens` falls back to the sum of the buckets. Message identity is `(sessionID, turn, step, attempt)`: attempts replace within one attempt and accumulate across `llm/retry-started` boundaries.
- **Forks**: only usage after the last inherited seed is counted. A seeded session with no inherited marker produces zero rows and a warning instead of guessing. Failed attempts use the `request/context` snapshot; a fork keeps the last pre-cut snapshot as its initial route.
- **Dates and time zones**: the statistics time zone is fixed to the process start zone. `Date` is derived from the first-seen timestamp when results are built, never cached; switching time zones requires rebuilding the database (documented).
- **Zero-value reversal**: when a key's final sample is an explicit zero after a non-zero sample, the stored row is deleted in the same transaction as the upsert. Rows that remain because their stored date differs from the requested range are reported as a warning with both dates; deleting zero rows is treated as idempotent completion.
- **Documentation**: both `docs/architecture*.md` and `docs/cli*.md` list DSH, its path key, catch-up behavior, and the client/source values; READMEs list it among supported collectors.

### Fixed
- **Nothing regressed for existing clients.** The new work is additive: shared `FileScanStatus` gained an opted-in `TruncatedTail`/`OversizedLines` signal, and the DSH persistence plan only runs when a DSH batch carries obsolete rows. All existing collector, engine, daemon, and CLI tests keep passing.
- **Verified against real DSH data.** On a real machine with 1,184 collected requests, 23 of 24 non-fork sessions matched their `session_projcache` totals session-by-session; the remaining session's projection cache lagged one record, and the 460,454 tokens the collector had already read correspond to that record. Three fork sessions counted only their own usage (458,224 / 895,013 / 55,226 tokens), matching the design contract.

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`, then enable the collector:

```toml
[clients.dsh]
enabled = true

[clients.dsh.paths]
sessions_dir = "~/.dsh/sessions"
```

After editing the configuration, restart the daemon if it is running (`token-usage daemon restart`), or start it (`token-usage daemon start`). Startup catch-up scans existing DSH history; you can also backfill manually with `token-usage collect all --client dsh`.

<!-- zh -->
v0.2.2 新增 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）作为一等采集客户端：`~/.dsh/sessions` 下的桌面端/CLI 会话日志现在会被采集，包含 fork 继承前缀、重试尝试与零值撤销。本版本没有破坏性的命令合同变更。

### 亮点
- **DSH 已可采集。** DSH 每个会话一份只追加 JSONL（默认由 zstd 拼接帧组成），首行 `session` header 带 `id`、`cwd`、`parentSession`、`isSeeded`，逐条 `assistant/message` 带 provider/model 与四桶用量。采集器负责发现会话、扫描 zstd 帧边界、在预算内解码完整帧，并按 `(turn, step, attempt)` 入账。fork 会话以最后一条 `session/end-seed{inherited:true}` 为切点：只算子会话自有用量，绝不重复计入继承前缀。当前只支持 **v4** 会话格式（明文与 `.zstd` 日志），其他版本会跳过并告警。结构不完整的 zstd 尾帧会整帧跳过，不尝试恢复其中的部分记录；若源文件后续没有被修复，该帧里的用量可能持续缺失。
- **daemon 不依赖文件监听也能采集 DSH。** DSH 日志是 zstd 帧，而 JSONL watcher 只认 `.jsonl`，因此 DSH 走周期全量提交。只启用 `dsh` 也能 `daemon start`；未变化的会话命中解析缓存，仍会重放结果供引擎幂等落库。

### 新增与变更
- **配置**：`[clients.dsh]` 与 `paths.sessions_dir`，默认 `~/.dsh/sessions`。`collect --client dsh`、`errors --source dsh`、`config init` 均已包含；不读取 `DSH_HOME`，自定义根目录的用户显式设置 `sessions_dir`。
- **口径**：`inputTokens` 已是未缓存输入，因此 FreshInput 等于 Input（不扣 cache）；`outputTokens` 含 reasoning；`totalTokens` 缺失时按四桶之和派生。消息身份按 `(sessionID, turn, step, attempt)` 确定：同一次尝试内后写替换，跨 `llm/retry-started` 累加。
- **fork**：只计最后一条继承 seed 之后的用量。`isSeeded` 但找不到继承标记时产出 0 条并告警，不做猜测。失败 attempt 使用 `request/context` 快照；fork 保留切点前最后一个快照作为初始路由。
- **日期与时区**：统计时区固定为进程启动时区。`Date` 在构造结果时由首次样本时间现算，不进入缓存；切换时区需重建数据库（文档已声明）。
- **零值撤销**：某 key 曾出现非零样本、最终样本为明确 0 时，在同一事务内删除旧行再 upsert。删除后仍有残留（通常是落库日期与请求范围不符）时告警并附请求日期与实际日期；删除 0 行按幂等完成处理，不告警。
- **文档**：`docs/architecture*.md` 与 `docs/cli*.md` 双语补齐 DSH、路径键、catch-up 与 client/source 取值；README 的 collector 列表已加入。

### 修复
- **既有客户端无回归。** 本次为增量改动：共享的 `FileScanStatus` 增加了可选启用的 `TruncatedTail`/`OversizedLines` 信号，DSH 持久化计划只在本轮带撤销行时执行。既有 collector、engine、daemon 与 CLI 测试全部通过。
- **真实 DSH 数据验证。** 在真实机器上采集 1,184 条请求：24 个非 fork 会话中，23 个与 `session_projcache` 总量逐会话一致；另 1 个会话的投影缓存滞后一条记录，采集侧多出的 460,454 token 与该记录对应。3 个 fork 会话只算自有用量（458,224 / 895,013 / 55,226 token），与设计合同一致。

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级，然后启用采集：

```toml
[clients.dsh]
enabled = true

[clients.dsh.paths]
sessions_dir = "~/.dsh/sessions"
```

修改配置后，若 daemon 正在运行，执行 `token-usage daemon restart`；若尚未运行，执行 `token-usage daemon start`。启动补采会扫描现有 DSH 历史；也可先运行 `token-usage collect all --client dsh` 手动回填。
